name: OMER S.p.A.
summary: OMER S.p.A. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells components and interior furnishings for railway vehicles in Italy, rest of European Union countries, and internationally. The company’s products include high speed and regional trains, and subway interiors; upper, side, and lower external fairings and girths for carriages and locomotives; and sanitary modules for trains. It works in partnership with rolling stock manufacturers engaging in the construction of finished railway vehicles. OMER S.p.A. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Carini, Italy.
